verdict.rationale: The vLLM GitHub README documents that the project can be built from source for development, so the core build-from-source path exists. Nothing in the pack describes the dependency footprint or shows that a source build needs only minimal external dependencies, and the only install command shown pulls in a torch backend. missing for 10: build-from-source instructions or depth, any evidence of a minimal or optional dependency set, independent or hands-on corroboration of source builds.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build the runtime from source with minimal external dependencies

citations.quote: Or build from source for development.
